content: Loscar, Baglietto & Vazquez (2021) PRE 104,034111 'Noisy multistate voter model for flocking in finite dimensions': each moving particle copies the direction of one randomly chosen neighbor within R plus noise eta; distinct from Vicsek's neighbor-averaging and from the classical lattice voter model (binary/discrete opinion consensus dynamics, no motion) that dominates generic 'voter model' web search results.
